ios.desc:
Are you a language learner who knows the basics but struggles to hold real conversations? You’re not alone. Many learners build a foundation through apps and classes but hit a wall when trying to actually speak the language. Traditional tools often fall short in providing practical, conversation-focused practice.

Lingopeel is designed for you—the language learner ready to move beyond the basics and start conversing confidently. Whether you’ve been using apps like Duolingo or took language courses in school, Lingopeel helps you practice real-life conversations and improve your speaking skills.

Why Choose Lingopeel?
• Simulated Conversations: Engage in realistic scenarios covering diverse topics, with the ability to create your own custom scenarios on any topic you want!
• Vocabulary Building: Practice vocabulary with fun exercises that utilize Spaced Repetition to automatically pick the words you should practice next!
• Real-Time Feedback: Receive instant, accurate corrections and suggestions to improve your grammar, vocabulary, and pronunciation.
• Direct Developer Support: Skip the usual support channels and communicate directly with the developer for fast, personalized responses.
• Continuous Improvement: Benefit from constant updates that bring new content, features, and enhancements based on your feedback.
• Supporting Multiple Languages: Lingopeel supports Korean, Japanese, Chinese, Spanish, English, French, German, Italian, and Portuguese.

Privacy Policy: https://www.lingopeel.com/privacy
Terms of Service: https://www.lingopeel.com/terms
